changes.details: Issue 138 changes Responses replay acceptance and issue 141 remains a stochastic workaround with outstanding two-rank validation, so neither is silently enabled in this exact recipe. Candidate qualification remains pending a fresh two-Spark canary.
changes.summary: Advanced the reviewed Mia source authority to 03d4776 without enabling its unqualified optional compatibility and sparse-MLA workarounds.

changes.details: Future safe runtime tunables can be admitted by a digest-bound distribution update without requiring a Spark agent or control-plane allowlist release. Reserved and code-injection variables remain blocked centrally.
changes.summary: Moved Mia-specific cache and NCCL diagnostics environment authority into the exact runtime distribution.

changes.details: Vonk's typed recipe already bounds the numeric knobs added upstream; the candidate now persists the new compile cache and rank diagnostics under the writable outputs mount.
changes.summary: Advanced the reviewed Mia two-Spark source to 70a7cc4 with persistent B12X compile caching and NCCL flight-recorder diagnostics.

changes.details: This records Mia's new boot-warmup coverage as qualification evidence without treating a future physical canary as already passed.
changes.summary: Added a sampler-shape canary for top-k, top-p, and combined sampling paths.

changes.details: Mixed prefill no longer creates extra persistent-cache variants from traffic-dependent sliced-pointer alignment.
changes.summary: Added Mia's issue 133 fix that bounds global top-k Triton compilation to the two stable block-size variants.

changes.details: The previous patch targeted vllm/v1/spec_decode/dspark.py, which is absent from the pinned image. The build now verifies the exact current NVIDIA DSpark loader and its layer-scoped gate/up shard mapping before applying any patches.
changes.summary: Replaced the obsolete legacy-overlay shared-expert patch with a fail-closed build gate for the loader already integrated in the pinned Anemll runtime.
Kept the recipe Candidate pending a fresh two-Spark image build and inference/speculative-decoding canary.
Advanced the official checkpoint authority to 7872f01; only README guidance changed and all 73 executable artifacts remain byte-identical.
Retained the Mia patch/runtime authority because every weight, configuration, tokenizer, encoding, and inference file is byte-identical.
Kept the recipe Candidate pending a fresh two-Spark import, inference, and speculative-decoding canary.

changes.details: The build now maps shared_experts.w1 and shared_experts.w3 into the fused gate_up_proj parameter and fails closed if the pinned DSpark overlay drifts.
changes.summary: Backported Mia's Stage-C shared-expert loader fix for the DSpark gate and up checkpoint shards.
Kept the recipe Candidate pending a fresh two-Spark build and inference/speculative-decoding canary.
Switched from the historical DSpark preview snapshot to the official DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 checkpoint.

Enabled regular CUDA graphs, the GB10 spin-wait fix, persistent JIT caches, and the validated 0.835 text-serving memory profile.

metadata.description: Complete offline Candidate TP8 recipe for Thinking Machines' flagship Inkling NVFP4 checkpoint. Its exact eight-rank topology is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 296.0 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead. The executable contract remains installable for a future eight-Spark canary and has no DGX Spark physical evidence. Inkling Small NVFP4 dual is the same-family alternative for text, image, and 16 kHz WAV audio, but its current 128 GB Controller admission envelope also needs either at least 128 GB free per node or a separately proven lower-memory profile.

metadata.description: Executable Pending single-DGX-Spark session-replay job for OpenMOSS MOSS-VL-Realtime. changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Pinned DiffSynth-Studio 2.1.5 at commit 84f93fc4, disk-mapped each safetensors expert with a 64 GiB device-residency threshold, isolated global and local stages in separate processes, and retained the 921,600-pixel generation bound. The 126 GB declared envelope passes Controller capacity admission but remains explicitly physical-OOM-gated.

slots.label: Prompt

slots.description: Required portrait reference image for the dancer identity and appearance.
slots.label: Reference image

slots.description: Required 1 to 5 second music clip that drives the generated dance.
slots.label: Music

slots.description: Optional JSON controls for style, dimensions, inference steps, and guidance scale. Height and width must remain within their documented per-dimension bounds, be multiples of 16, and define no more than 921,600 pixels.
slots.label: Generation controls

slots.description: Generated H.264/AAC MP4 at 30 fps, cropped to the reference-image aspect with frame count and duration derived from the 1 to 5 second music input.
slots.label: Dance video

metadata.description: Installable single-DGX Spark Candidate for Wan-Dancer's official global-planning and local-refinement music-to-dance pipeline, with isolated reference-image, music, style and prompt inputs. Generation is bounded to a 921,600-pixel canvas (including 720x1280 portrait and 1280x720 landscape). Controller admission still requires the full declared 128 GB memory envelope; physical Spark memory, quality, and latency acceptance remain pending.
